acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Digestion was performed using trypsin at 37 °C overnight.

collision_energy.evidence: The top 10 most abundant peptides were isolated within a 1.8 Th window and subjected to HCD fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 27%.
